title: Cloud koncepti i referentna arhitektura
summary: NIST i ISO/IEC 17788/17789 definicije, uloge (customer, provider, partner, broker, auditor, regulator), esencijalne karakteristike, SaaS/PaaS/IaaS, deployment modeli, shared considerations (portability, reversibility…) i uticaj AI, kvantnog i confidential computinga.
summary_en: NIST and ISO/IEC 17788/17789 definitions, roles (customer, provider, partner, broker, auditor, regulator), essential characteristics, SaaS/PaaS/IaaS, deployment models, shared considerations (portability, reversibility…) and the impact of AI, quantum and confidential computing.
